name: Cefoperazone + Sulbactam
drafted_by: AI-assisted draft (Claude) for review by Dr. W. Rivero

usual_adult_dose.dose: 2 to 4 g/day IV or IM in divided doses every 12 hours; up to 8 g/day (sulbactam maximum 4 g/day)

key_interactions.action: Avoid during and for 5 days after.
Do not mix; separate lines; monitor kidney function.

serious: Bleeding from vitamin K deficiency (fatal cases)

contraindications: Hypersensitivity to sulbactam, cefoperazone or other beta-lactams

pk.half_life: Sulbactam about 1 hour; cefoperazone about 1.7 hours
pk.half_life_eskd: Sulbactam 6.9 to 9.7 hours in anephric patients; cefoperazone unchanged (prolonged 2- to 4-fold in severe liver disease)
pk.excretion_renal_pct: Sulbactam about 84% in urine; cefoperazone about 25% (rest biliary)

sources.citation: Sance Laboratories Private Limited. (2023). Cerazone Plus-500 (cefoperazone/sulbactam 500 mg/500 mg) dry powder for injection [Summary of product characteristics, MA SANCE/IND/770; text revised July 25, 2023]. Ethiopian Food and Drug Authority.
